unsharpmask.desc: Sharpens the image by comparing it to a blurred version of itself and boosting the difference, controlled by Amount and Radius.

pixelate.desc: Blocks the image into large flat squares to create a chunky, mosaic look, sized by Block Size.

addnoise.desc: Sprinkles random per-pixel grain onto the image, with Amount controlling how strong the speckling is.

vignette.desc: Darkens the corners and edges around a center point, with Amount for strength and Radius/Softness for how far the darkening spreads.

transform.desc: Moves, scales, and rotates the whole image using Translate, Scale, and Rotation controls, leaving anything pushed outside the frame transparent.

lensdistortion.chapter: 2D Image Effects — The Full Filter Shelf
lensdistortion.desc: Bulges or pinches the image like a camera lens and fringes the edges with color, controlled by Barrel curvature and Chromatic Aberration amount.

displace.chapter: 2D Image Effects — The Full Filter Shelf
displace.desc: Pushes pixels sideways using either a second connected image as a displacement map or, with nothing plugged in, an animated wavy pattern.

liquify.chapter: 2D Image Effects — The Full Filter Shelf
liquify.desc: Warps the image with a smooth, flowing animated distortion like moving liquid, shaped by Amount, Scale, and Speed.

symmetry.chapter: 2D Image Effects — The Full Filter Shelf
symmetry.desc: Mirrors one half of the image onto the other across a chosen axis and center point, with an option to flip the whole result.

crop.chapter: 2D Image Effects — The Full Filter Shelf
crop.desc: Trims the edges of the image by set Left/Right/Top/Bottom amounts, then either leaves the trimmed area transparent, zooms in to fill the frame, or fills it with a solid color.

emboss.chapter: 2D Image Effects — The Full Filter Shelf
emboss.desc: Turns the image into a raised, carved-relief look by comparing pixels on either side of a light direction, with Amount and Angle controlling depth and lighting.

convolve.chapter: 2D Image Effects — The Full Filter Shelf
convolve.desc: Runs a custom 3×3 grid of numbers over every pixel and its neighbors, letting you dial in blur, sharpen, edge, or emboss-style looks from nine kernel values.

halftone.chapter: 2D Image Effects — The Full Filter Shelf
halftone.desc: Recreates the image using a grid of dots sized by brightness (like a newspaper print), with Scale controlling dot density.

lookup.chapter: 2D Image Effects — The Full Filter Shelf
lookup.desc: A related color-remap node that reads a reference gradient/table image to redirect each pixel's color.

gradientmap.chapter: 2D Image Effects — The Full Filter Shelf
gradientmap.desc: Recolors the image by mapping its brightness onto a custom two-color (or multi-stop) gradient.

posterize.chapter: 2D Image Effects — The Full Filter Shelf
posterize.desc: Reduces the image to a limited number of tonal steps per channel for a flat, poster-print look.

threshold.chapter: 2D Image Effects — The Full Filter Shelf
threshold.desc: Converts the image to pure black and white based on a brightness cutoff point.

exposure.chapter: 2D Image Effects — The Full Filter Shelf
exposure.desc: Brightens or darkens the whole image in stops, the same control a camera's exposure dial gives you.

outerglow.chapter: 2D Image Effects — The Full Filter Shelf
outerglow.desc: Adds a soft colored glow that blooms outward from the image's edges or transparency, with Amount for strength and Color for tint.

coloroverlay.chapter: 2D Image Effects — The Full Filter Shelf
coloroverlay.desc: Tints the whole image toward a single flat color, with Opacity controlling how strongly the tint replaces the original colors.

dropshadow.chapter: 2D Image Effects — The Full Filter Shelf
dropshadow.desc: Casts a soft offset shadow of the image's silhouette behind it, with Offset X/Y for direction and distance and Opacity/Color for its look.

dynamics.desc: A compressor that squashes loud peaks down once they cross a Threshold, tightening dynamics by a set Ratio, with Attack/Release/Makeup rounding out the feel.

limiter.desc: A brick-wall ceiling that catches anything above the Threshold and prevents it from getting louder, with In/Out Gain to drive it harder or make up level.

stereo.desc: Widens or narrows the stereo image with a Width knob (0 collapses to mono), plus Pan and a Bass Mono control that keeps low end centered.

pitchshifter.desc: Shifts pitch up or down by semitones (up to two octaves either way) using a delay-line pitch shifter, with Grain size shaping the artifacts.

chorus.desc: Thickens the sound with multiple slightly detuned, delayed copies, with Delay time and Depth of the wobble and a free or tempo-synced Rate.

flanger.desc: Creates a sweeping, jet-plane whoosh by mixing a short modulating delay with Feedback back into the signal.

phaser.desc: Sweeps notches through the sound for a swirling effect, set by a Cutoff center frequency, Depth, and Rate.

transientshaper.desc: Reshapes the punch of a sound by independently boosting or cutting the Attack (the initial hit) and the Sustain (the tail).

stutter.desc: Repeats a short slice of audio like a glitchy loop, with tempo-synced or free timing and a step/gate mask controlling which repeats play.

ringmod.desc: Multiplies the signal by an oscillator to produce bell-like, metallic, robotic tones, with adjustable frequency and waveform.

frequencyshifter.desc: Shifts every frequency in the sound up or down by a fixed Hz amount (not musically, like pitch), creating inharmonic textures, with Feedback adding spiraling "barber pole" motion.

tremolo.desc: Pulses the volume up and down with an LFO, set by Depth and a free or tempo-synced Rate.

formantfilter.desc: Gives the sound a vowel-like, talking/singing quality by morphing between A-E-I-O-U formant shapes, with Q controlling resonance.

wavetableshaper.desc: Distorts the sound by running it through a chosen wavetable, with Table picking the waveform set, Position scanning through it, and Drive controlling intensity.
